_comment: Annotations for the top-level src/ tree rendered into architecture.md. The STRUCTURE (which top-level dirs exist) is read from the filesystem; this file supplies the one-line annotation the tree can't derive. buildTree coverage-asserts the two agree — a new top-level dir under src/ with no entry here fails the build, and an entry with no dir fails too. Entries with show:false are annotated (so they're documented and coverage-checked) but kept out of the T1 'three layers' view; that view shows only the three architectural layers. Order here is render order. Trailing-slash keys are directories.

app/.note: the shell — providers, router, the root layout every page mounts inside

shared/.note: cross-feature primitives: the typed API client, UI components, hooks, Zustand stores

features/.note: one folder per surface — auth, transactions, taxation, budgets, … (the product)

content/.note: authored documents compiled at build time — the legal texts and their generated modules

test/.note: shared MSW test infrastructure (mock server + handlers)

capture/.note: dev-only screenshot capture gallery (feeds the user manual)

embed/.note: headless routes the native app loads in a WebView (e.g. /embed/glance courier)

main.tsx.note: entrypoint — mounts the providers, router and routes
